subject.title: fix(plugins): bound marketplace manifest file reads

question: Should marketplace manifests adopt the shared regular-file-only boundary despite breaking existing symlinked manifest paths?
rationale: Rejecting symlinks prevents cloned or local marketplace paths from redirecting the manifest read, but it changes a documented input surface beyond the reported unbounded-allocation bug.

options.title: Adopt regular-file-only
options.body: Accept the limited compatibility impact to keep marketplace manifest reads bounded and pinned to regular files.

options.title: Preserve symlinks safely
options.body: Pause merge and implement a bounded, root-contained symlink policy if symlink support is an intended contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt regular-file-only
recommendation.body: Accept the limited compatibility impact to keep marketplace manifest reads bounded and pinned to regular files.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent introduced the marketplace loader behavior and is the strongest history-based owner for its permanent input contract.
